## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta10

### Organize editor controls and header buttons
- Move **Show custom areas** into **Displayed information**.
- Move Custom Area **Fill opacity** and **Border width** into **Appearance**.
- Move **Custom area color** into **Colors**, so related visual controls stay together.
- Add Displayed information toggles for the **History**, **Notifications**, **Schedule**, and **Settings** header buttons. All remain enabled by default for existing cards.
- When History is hidden, return the card to **Current cycle** so an inaccessible historical view cannot remain selected.
- Fix black `VF off`, `Gate area`, and `Custom area` swatches whose labels could overlap the color preview in Home Assistant's visual editor.

Current-cycle rendering, History archives, scheduler behavior, mower rendering and map performance remain unchanged.
